title: Speakboard token export
description: Schema 1.3.0, generated together with token set 0.2.2: the device class ids, source ids and token ids it lists are that token set's. Rules JSON Schema cannot express are checked by validate-tokens.py and listed in the brand book's 'Token export format' section.

ios.description: Exact iOS version of the capture, e.g. 26.1.

device.description: Model and device class, e.g. iPhone 16 (iphone-393x852), or the simulator runtime.

capture.description: Reference to the capture: CI run, file path and content hash.
